source: Do not turn this into a universal slogan that attention is always “memory-bound.” The bottleneck depends on sequence lengths, head dimension, dtype, mask pattern, ZXNAME0000XZ generation, forward vs. backward, and which kernel is running. FA3 and FA4 exist partly because, as hardware changed, the dominant bottlenecks changed too.[6, 7]
zh: 不要把这变成一个普遍的口号，即注意力总是“受记忆限制”。瓶颈取决于序列长度、头部尺寸、数据类型、掩码模式、ZXNAME0000XZ 生成、前向与后向以及正在运行的内核。 FA3 和 FA4 存在的部分原因是，随着硬件的变化，主要瓶颈也发生了变化。[6, 7]
